purpose: Third experiment-calibrated sample16 AC3D SIP candidate using BiCGSTAB after COCG residual diagnostics.

relationship_to_previous.diagnosis: The COCG v2 all-7 run had high residuals at several frequencies. A BiCGSTAB probe at 1068.520351 Hz reduced the residual to about 4.3e-3 and showed the imaginary response was still too large by roughly a factor of five.
relationship_to_previous.change: Keep the successful y direction, solid background conductivity, and membrane_length_scale=0.1; reduce membrane_polarizability_eta0 from 0.0013 to 0.00026 and use gpu-bicgstab-compact.

diagnostic_plan.decision_rule: If v3 seven-point diagnostics preserve the real-conductivity baseline and bring the imaginary-conductivity amplitude/trend near LKC-16, use v3 settings for the full 51-frequency sweep.
